title: Convex Polygon
description:
You are given an array of points on the X-Y plane points where points[i] = [xi, yi]. The points form a polygon when joined sequentially.
Return true if this polygon is convex and false otherwise.
You may assume the polygon formed by given points is always a simple polygon. In other words, we ensure that exactly two edges intersect at each vertex and that edges otherwise don't intersect each other.
 
Example 1:


Input: points = [[0,0],[0,5],[5,5],[5,0]]
Output: true

Example 2:


Input: points = [[0,0],[0,10],[10,10],[10,0],[5,5]]
Output: false

 
Constraints:

3 <= points.length <= 104
points[i].length == 2
-104 <= xi, yi <= 104
All the given points are unique.

    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [0, 5], [5, 5], [5, 0]]) == True
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [0, 10], [10, 10], [10, 0], [5, 5]]) == False
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [2, 0], [3, 1], [2, 2], [0, 2]]) == True
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [2, 0], [1, 1], [2, 2], [0, 2]]) == False
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0], [2, 2], [0, 2]]) == True
    assert candidate(points = [[1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0], [0, -1]]) == True
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [3, 0], [3, 3], [1, 1], [0, 3]]) == False
    assert candidate(points = [[0, 0], [4, 0], [5, 2], [3, 4], [1, 4], [-1, 2]]) == True
